title: [Feature Request]:torch.dtype.kindequivalent tonumpy.dtype.kind
bug_description:
### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch

NumPy has the [`numpy.dtype.kind`](https://numpy.org/doc/stable/reference/generated/numpy.dtype.kind.html) attribute which identifies the general kind of data using character codes. Some packages like [Astropy](https://astropy.org/) use the `kind` attribute to check the datatype of arrays, e.g., in
[`astropy.coordinates.Angle`](https://docs.astropy.org/en/stable/api/astropy.coordinates.Angle.html).

Are there any plans to implement a `torch.dtype.kind` equivalent to `numpy.dtype.kind`?
